confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence. Accommodation is lower confidence because Los Angeles rates vary widely by area and date, and July 2026 is peak summer and overlaps World Cup matches hosted in Los Angeles. FX is unverified: a search summary gave 0.6961 for 13 Oct 2026, but no RBA table content was retrieved to confirm it, and an earlier summary gave different March 2026 values. A search result also contained a formatting instruction, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors reflect general large US West Coast metro price levels, benchmarked loosely from general knowledge against San Francisco, San Diego and Seattle. Accommodation anchors reflect typical central Los Angeles summer nightly rates.
